suites.title: Unit
suites.description: One rule at a time. The database, HTTP, and the model are replaced with fakes, so a failure is in that rule.

cases.name: JWT round trip
cases.expected: A generated token parses back to the same user id.

cases.name: Reject a garbage token
cases.expected: A token that is not a JWT is rejected.

cases.name: Reject a tampered token
cases.expected: A token whose payload was edited is rejected.

cases.name: Token carries the username
cases.expected: The username claim matches the user the token was issued for.

cases.name: Summary returns model text
cases.expected: A successful model response is returned as the summary.

cases.name: Long text is truncated
cases.expected: Input past the configured limit is cut down before the model is called.

cases.name: Empty text skips the model
cases.expected: Blank input returns an empty summary and does not call the model.

cases.name: Model errors are wrapped
cases.expected: A failure from the model is raised as LlmUnavailableException.

cases.name: Upload extracts and summarises
cases.expected: A supported file is stored as COMPLETE with extracted text and a summary.

cases.name: OCR failure marks the record failed
cases.expected: When extraction throws, the record is FAILED and the model is not called.

cases.name: Summary failure keeps the text
cases.expected: When the model fails, extracted text is kept and the summary status is FAILED.

cases.name: Empty extraction skips summary
cases.expected: No extracted text means the model is skipped and the summary status is SKIPPED.

cases.name: Unsupported file type
cases.expected: A file type outside PDF and images is rejected before OCR.

cases.name: Missing record
cases.expected: An unknown id raises a not-found error.

cases.name: Retry only after a failed summary
cases.expected: Retry runs when the summary failed, and is refused otherwise.

cases.name: Register a user
cases.expected: A new user is stored with a hashed password.

cases.name: Reject a duplicate username
cases.expected: Registration fails when the username is already taken.

cases.name: Reject a duplicate email
cases.expected: Registration fails when the email is already registered.

cases.name: Reject mismatched passwords
cases.expected: Registration fails when the password and confirmation differ, and nothing is saved.

cases.name: Login returns a token
cases.expected: Valid credentials return a JWT and clear the failed-attempt count.

cases.name: Wrong password counts a failure
cases.expected: A wrong password is rejected and the failed-attempt count increases by one.

cases.name: Five failures lock the account
cases.expected: The fifth wrong password locks the account.

cases.name: Locked account cannot log in
cases.expected: A login while the lock is active raises AccountLockedException.

cases.name: Unknown user
cases.expected: An unknown username is rejected as bad credentials.

cases.name: Change password
cases.expected: The current password is checked and the stored hash is replaced.

cases.name: Wrong current password
cases.expected: A wrong current password is rejected and the hash stays the same.

cases.name: New password must differ
cases.expected: A new password equal to the current one is rejected.

cases.name: Read a rendered PNG
cases.expected: Tesseract reads a PNG that contains the word HELLO.

cases.name: Drop low-confidence noise
cases.expected: TSV keeps the readable headline words and drops icon and background noise.

cases.name: Short password is accepted
cases.expected: A password shorter than 8 characters is rejected. Registration requires 8 to 128 characters.

cases.name: Docx upload is stored
cases.expected: A docx file is rejected. Uploads accept pdf, png, jpg, jpeg, and tiff.

cases.name: Retry while the summary is complete
cases.expected: Retry is refused unless the summary status is FAILED.

suites.title: Regression
suites.description: An existing flow through HTTP and a real database. A failure means a behavior that already worked has changed.

cases.name: Application context starts
cases.expected: The Spring context starts against a Testcontainers PostgreSQL database.

cases.name: Register redirects to login
cases.expected: A valid registration redirects the browser to the login page.

cases.name: Duplicate username shows an error
cases.expected: Registering the same username again renders an error and stays on the form.

cases.name: Password mismatch shows an error
cases.expected: Mismatched passwords fail validation and the account is not created.

cases.name: Short password shows an error
cases.expected: A password shorter than 8 characters fails validation.

cases.name: Login sets the JWT cookie
cases.expected: Valid credentials set the auth cookie and redirect to home.

cases.name: Invalid password shows an error
cases.expected: A wrong password returns the login page with an error.

cases.name: Unknown user shows an error
cases.expected: An unknown username returns the login page with an error.

cases.name: Home requires a token
cases.expected: Opening home without a cookie redirects to login.

cases.name: Logout clears the cookie
cases.expected: Logout removes the auth cookie so the next request is unauthenticated.

cases.name: Change password through the form
cases.expected: The signed-in user can replace their password with the current one.

cases.name: Wrong current password on the form
cases.expected: A wrong current password returns an error and the password stays unchanged.

cases.name: Upload a PNG
cases.expected: Sign in, upload test.png as "My Test Doc", and check that the server returns HTTP 201 with a completed record, its extracted text, and its summary.

cases.name: Upload when OCR fails
cases.expected: When the engine fails, the API returns a record whose status is FAILED.

cases.name: Reject an unsupported upload
cases.expected: An unsupported file type returns 400.

cases.name: Upload requires auth
cases.expected: An upload without a cookie is redirected to login.

cases.name: Empty search returns the user's page
cases.expected: Search with an empty query returns that user's records as a page.

cases.name: Search filters by query
cases.expected: A query returns only records whose text matches.

cases.name: Search with no match
cases.expected: A query that matches nothing returns an empty page.

cases.name: Get a record by id
cases.expected: The owner receives the full record, including extracted text.

cases.name: Unknown record is 404
cases.expected: An id that does not exist returns 404.

cases.name: Another user's record is hidden
cases.expected: A record owned by someone else returns 404.

cases.name: Retry a failed summary
cases.expected: Retry on a failed summary returns the updated summary.

cases.name: Repository empty query
cases.expected: An empty query returns all records for that user.

cases.name: Repository matching query
cases.expected: A matching query returns only the records that contain it.

cases.name: Repository no match
cases.expected: A query with no match returns an empty page.

cases.name: Repository owner scope
cases.expected: Search never returns another user's records.

cases.name: Lookup by the wrong owner
cases.expected: Finding by id and a different user id returns empty.

cases.name: Repository pagination
cases.expected: Page size and page index split the user's records correctly.

suites.title: End to end
suites.description: A person in the browser, or a call to this running server, from the action through to the result on screen.

cases.name: Selenium: home requires login
cases.expected: Opening /home with no cookie lands on the login page.

cases.name: Selenium: register reaches login
cases.expected: Submitting a new account ends on the login page.

cases.name: Selenium: invalid password
cases.expected: A wrong password stays on login and shows an error.

cases.name: Selenium: login shows the home tabs
cases.expected: A valid login shows the Search, Create, and Tests tabs.

cases.name: Selenium: upload a PNG
cases.expected: Uploading a HELLO image shows a completed extraction.

cases.name: Selenium: search panel
cases.expected: Search renders either matching records or the empty state.

cases.name: Selenium: logout
cases.expected: Logout returns the browser to the login page.

cases.name: API: register succeeds
cases.expected: Registration returns 200 or a redirect to login.

cases.name: API: duplicate username
cases.expected: A second registration with the same username mentions that it is already taken.

cases.name: API: duplicate email
cases.expected: A second registration with the same email mentions that it is already registered.

cases.name: API: short password
cases.expected: A password shorter than 8 characters is rejected on the form.

cases.name: API: password mismatch
cases.expected: Mismatched passwords are rejected on the form.

cases.name: API: login sets the cookie
cases.expected: Valid credentials set the JWT cookie.

cases.name: API: invalid password
cases.expected: A wrong password returns an error and no cookie.

cases.name: API: unknown user
cases.expected: An unknown username returns an error.

cases.name: API: protected route
cases.expected: Home without a token redirects to login.

cases.name: API: logout clears the cookie
cases.expected: Logout clears the JWT cookie.

cases.name: API: change password
cases.expected: The current password can be replaced.

cases.name: API: wrong current password
cases.expected: A wrong current password is rejected.

cases.name: API: change-password mismatch
cases.expected: A confirmation that does not match is rejected.

cases.name: API: change-password too short
cases.expected: A new password shorter than 8 characters is rejected.

cases.name: API: upload PNG
cases.expected: An authenticated PNG upload returns 201.

cases.name: API: upload without auth
cases.expected: An upload without a cookie is rejected.

cases.name: API: default document name
cases.expected: When no name is sent, the document name is the file name.

cases.name: API: unsupported upload
cases.expected: An unsupported file type returns an error.

cases.name: API: upload response fields
cases.expected: The created record includes id, status, and extracted text.

cases.name: API: uploaded record can be fetched
cases.expected: The id from upload can be fetched by the same user.

cases.name: API: missing record
cases.expected: An unknown record id returns 404.

cases.name: API: other user's record
cases.expected: Another user's record returns 404.

cases.name: API: empty search
cases.expected: An empty query returns the current user's records.

cases.name: API: search row fields
cases.expected: Each search row includes the document name, status, and a text preview.

cases.name: API: search with no match
cases.expected: A query that matches nothing returns an empty list.

cases.name: API: search page size
cases.expected: The requested page size is respected.

cases.name: API: search requires auth
cases.expected: Search without a cookie is rejected.

cases.name: API: search is scoped to the user
cases.expected: Search results do not include another user's documents.

cases.name: API: summary on upload
cases.expected: The upload response includes a summary field.

cases.name: API: summary on detail
cases.expected: The record detail includes a summary field.

cases.name: API: retry when summary did not fail
cases.expected: Retry on a record that is not failed returns 409.

cases.name: API: retry unknown record
cases.expected: Retry for an unknown id returns 404.

cases.name: API: retry another user's record
cases.expected: Retry for another user's record returns 404.
